MY_LS
Reimplementation of the ls command

Binary name: my_ls
Repository name: B-PSU-100-my_ls
Language: C
Compilation: via Makefile, including re, clean and fclean rules
Authorized functions: opendir, readdir, closedir, stat, lstat, write, malloc,
free, getpwuid, getgrgid, time, ctime, readlink, perror, strerror, exit

DESCRIPTION

Your program must list the content of the given directories, or of the
current directory when no argument is given.
Your program should sort the entries in alphabetical order by default.
printf is forbidden: use write and your own formatting functions.
If an error occurs, the program must exit with 84.
You may use unit tests (criterion) with a tests_run rule in your Makefile.

OPTIONS

-a    do not ignore entries starting with .
-l    use a long listing format
-R    list subdirectories recursively
-d    list directories themselves, not their contents
-r    reverse order while sorting
-t    sort by modification time, newest first

EXAMPLES

∼/B-PSU-100> ./my_ls -l
total 12
-rw-r--r-- 1 jane jane  120 Oct 20 10:00 Makefile
drwxr-xr-x 2 jane jane 4096 Oct 20 10:00 src

∼/B-PSU-100> ./my_ls -a
.  ..  Makefile  src

BONUS

Handle colors depending on the file type.
Support the -h option for human readable sizes.
Display extended attributes.
